newsitem.title: UK: Hambro Countrywide sees good results for yr.
newsitem.headline: Hambro Countrywide sees good results for yr.

text.p: British investment bank Hambros Plc said on Wednesday it expected its estate agency network Hambro Countrywide Plc to report favourable results for the full year and carry forward a substantial pipeline of business into 1997.

"I confidently expect Hambro Countrywide to deliver a pleasing result for the full year and, at the same time, carry forward a substantial pipeline of business into 1997," Lord Hambro, chairman of Hambros Plc said in a statement.
He added that the UK housing market had held up well through the summer and autumn.
The steadily improving market and an increased market share helped Hambro Countrywide return to profitability in the first half of 1996.
